title: Wire the design-power addon-install flow + orchestrator-routing pointer
description: Phase G-4 (addon surface). Make the design-power pack push-button installable in any hivemind project, and make the orchestrator aware the whole addon/assimilate surface exists (today orchestrator-routing has ZERO mention of packs/assimilate). Add a documented, invocable install flow (a command under commands/ or a skill) that runs: check PROJECT.md profile -> pack-ctl resolve -> pack-ctl reconcile-apply -> report installed skills + the Wave-2 MCP/plugin resources left for the human. Add an orchestrator-routing SKILL.md section describing the addon-pack + assimilate protocol and pointing at hivemind-assimilate-skill + pack-ctl + packs/design-power. Surface the end-to-end story in README. Depends on TASK-134 + TASK-136.
acceptance_criteria: A documented, invocable install flow (command or skill) exists that drives pack-ctl resolve -> reconcile-apply for the active design-power pack and reports the skills materialized plus the Wave-2 MCP/plugin resources it did NOT install (with their descriptor install commands for the human).

skills/orchestrator-routing/SKILL.md gains a section on the addon-pack + assimilate surface that references hivemind-assimilate-skill, pack-ctl, and packs/design-power, so a fresh orchestrator can route to them.
README documents the design-heavy end-to-end path: init writes the profile -> the install flow reconciles the design skills -> assimilate adopts new third-party skills via the human gate.
All existing doc-lock / readme / routing / skills-parity sensors stay green (updated where they pin content).

comments.author: uat
comments.body:
UAT (verified by Orchestrator at the human's request — uat_delegated_to_orchestrator standing grant). Script derived from the 4 ACs; every AC covered, all steps PASS.

Step 1 (AC1) — Run: inspect commands/design-pack.md. Expect: an invocable flow that reads PROJECT.md profile then drives pack-ctl resolve -> reconcile-plan -> reconcile-apply, and honestly reports Wave-2 MCP/plugin gaps + routes skill adoption through the assimilate skill. Observed: lines 25/34/46 invoke the REAL `${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/dist/pack-ctl.cjs resolve|reconcile-plan|reconcile-apply`; 5 hits on skills-only/Wave-2/manual/hivemind-assimilate-skill making clear the reconciler is skills-only and vendoring routes through the assimilate skill (never shortcut). PASS.

Step 2 (AC2) — Run: grep skills/orchestrator-routing/SKILL.md for the addon surface. Expect: a section pointing at pack-ctl, packs/design-power, /hivemind:design-pack, and hivemind-assimilate-skill, with the human-gate noted. Observed: new '## Addon-pack + assimilate surface' section (L938+) referencing all four, stating hivemind-assimilate-skill is the ONLY supported third-party-skill adoption path. Byte-identical parity copy confirmed (diff -> IDENTICAL; enforced by orchestrator-routing-skill + orchestrator-skill-v2 byte-identity specs). PASS.

Step 3 (AC3) — Run: grep README.md. Expect: the design-heavy end-to-end path (init profile -> install flow -> assimilate for new skills). Observed: 'Design-heavy project?' day-two bullet (L169) pointing at /hivemind:design-pack. README stayed under the 200-line cap with no banned jargon. PASS.

Step 4 (AC4) — Run: the doc-lock/readme/routing sensors + full gate. Expect: all green. Observed (from developer hand-off, spot-confirmed): readme.spec 6/6, orchestrator-routing-skill 13/13, orchestrator-skill-v2 20/20, agility-doc-locks 15/15, calibration 33/33, plugin-scaffold 16/16, docs 2/2; npm test 892 passed/2 skip; npm run test:all 1632 passed/4 skipped. PASS.

Overall: PASS (4/4). Install-flow form = a commands/ entry (/hivemind:design-pack) mirroring the commands/loop.md -> dist/loop-ctl.cjs precedent. No new behavioral specs (uat-only budget honored).

comments.body:

README documents the design-heavy end-to-end path under the 200-line cap.

Install-flow form = a commands/ entry (/hivemind:design-pack) mirroring the commands/loop.md -> dist/loop-ctl.cjs precedent (correct: an invocable operator flow, not always-on routing knowledge). No .claude/commands/ dir exists, so no command parity copy needed.
